## Artist

::: {#artist-info .cell execution_count=3}
**John Baldessari**  ([Wikidata](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q683378))

- **Born:** 17 June 1931, National City
- **Died:** 2 January 2020, Venice
- **Nationality:** United States
- **Works as:** architect, conceptual artist, draftsperson, illustrator, installation artist, painter, photographer, printmaker, sculptor, video artist
- **Studied at:** San Diego State University; University of California, Berkeley
- **Awards:** Fellow of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences; Goslarer Kaiserring; Guggenheim Fellowship; Spectrum – Internationaler Preis für Fotografie
:::

```{=html}
<style>
  .sortable-table th { cursor: pointer; user-select: none; white-space: nowrap; }
  .sortable-table th::after { content: " \2195"; opacity: .35; }
  .sortable-table th[aria-sort="ascending"]::after { content: " \25B2"; opacity: 1; }
  .sortable-table th[aria-sort="descending"]::after { content: " \25BC"; opacity: 1; }
</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  document.querySelectorAll(".sortable-table table").forEach(function (table) {
    var body = table.tBodies[0];
    var heads = table.querySelectorAll("thead th");
    heads.forEach(function (th, col) {
      th.tabIndex = 0;
      var sort = function () {
        var dir = th.getAttribute("aria-sort") === "ascending" ? "descending" : "ascending";
        heads.forEach(function (h) { h.removeAttribute("aria-sort"); });
        th.setAttribute("aria-sort", dir);
        var sign = dir === "ascending" ? 1 : -1;
        var value = function (row) {
          var t = row.cells[col].textContent.trim();
          return t === "\u2013" ? "" : t;
        };
        Array.from(body.rows).sort(function (a, b) {
          var x = value(a), y = value(b);
          if (x === "" && y === "") return 0;
          if (x === "") return 1;
          if (y === "") return -1;
          return sign * x.localeCompare(y, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });
        }).forEach(function (row) { body.appendChild(row); });
      };
      th.addEventListener("click", sort);
      th.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); sort(); }
      });
    });
  });
});
</script>
```
